name: 11230 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11230 (Brooklyn) has 615 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 86 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11230 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 36 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 15 in similar places of this size.
